## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what this change does. Link related issues where relevant.

## Verification

List the checks run and their results. Explain any checks that could not run. Include a screenshot for visible UI changes, using public or synthetic data.

## Deployment, data, and compatibility

Describe any migration, configuration, API/MCP, provenance, dependency, or trust-policy impact. Write “None” if there is no impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Relevant verification has passed, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] No credentials, private inventories, database dumps, or generated runtime data are included.
- [ ] Source attribution and unknown-value semantics are preserved where applicable.
